item: fixedb_candidate_verify_v1 selftest (initial-scope stdlib probe; decimal / Fraction; validation of the candidate verifier, NOT a search)
admission: initial scope: frozen <=300 s stdlib probe, single process, <=256 MiB RSS, <=16 MiB output; no numpy/native; PID recorded by the wrapper before compute; launch-record path+sha sent to parent at launch
purpose: validate the exact (Fraction) Gram / ray-margin check and the high-precision (60-digit decimal) chord Gauss-Newton refinement + full Gram check on 1e-9-perturbed exact anchors (v=7 Huang-Li, v=8 Zhang-Cao) and a random-unitary negative control (v=7 cyclic B)
wrapper: /bin/bash -c 'echo START date PID $$ PGID; exec /usr/bin/env -i TMPDIR=<lane>/tmp <argv>' (exec keeps the PID)
wall_limit: tool timeout 0; operator kills the PGID if not finished by 280 s (expected < 90 s)
